text: Nexus [Lat. nexus , a bond, from nectere , to bind, tie]: Ger. Nexus ; Fr. nexus , lien : Ital. nesso . The mutual dependence of different elements of an ordered series upon one another; same as connection or relation, but containing in addition a suggestion of union into an ordered whole; most frequently used in the phrase 'Causal Nexus.' ( J.D. )
